locus: 1 November, In Festo Omnium Sanctorum: Introit and Collect artifact p. 862 / printed p. 748, left column; Secret and Postcommunion artifact p. 864 / printed p. 750, the latter crossing from left foot to right top. Four normalized bodies with their actual source cues.
rights_basis: Bounded historical Latin from the separately registered public-domain Tours Mame 1922 printing. This derivative contains only the All Saints Introit, Collect, Secret and Postcommunion read on its page images, with their actual abbreviated cues and conclusion lengths. It adds no modern wording and makes no new rights decision. The parent artifact records the United States publication and mechanical-reproduction basis.
text:
Gaudeamus omnes in Domino, diem festum celebrantes sub honore Sanctorum omnium:
de quorum solemnitate gaudent Angeli, et collaudant Filium Dei. Exsultate,
justi, in Domino: rectos decet collaudatio. ℣. Gloria Patri.

Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, qui nos omnium Sanctorum tuorum merita sub una
tribuisti celebritate venerari: quaesumus; ut desideratam nobis tuae
propitiationis abundantiam, multiplicatis intercessoribus, largiaris. Per
Dominum.

Munera tibi, Domine, nostrae devotionis offerimus: quae et pro cunctorum tibi
grata sint honore justorum, et nobis salutaria, te miserante, reddantur. Per
Dominum.

Da, quaesumus, Domine, fidelibus populis omnium Sanctorum semper veneratione
laetari: et eorum perpetua supplicatione muniri. Per Dominum.
